correctness.rationale: For A=V⊕(V⊗V), A^3=0, an anti-automorphism is uniquely L on V and arbitrary h:V→V⊗V, with quadratic action F=(L⊗L)flip. Squaring gives exactly L^2=I and hL+Fh=0. Odd q: eigenspace count by trace(F⊗L*)=n(2r-n) yields exponent (n^3-n(2r-n))/2; divide |GL_n| by centralizer |GL_r||GL_{n-r}| for each r. Even q: Jordan 1^r2^s, r+2s=n; F has n fixed tensor words and (n^2-n)/2 two-cycles. Module-hom dimension e=r n(n+1)/2+s n^2, centralizer q^(s^2+2rs)G_sG_r. Identity-linear conjugation translates h by im(I-T), yielding quotient dimension 2e-n^3=rn and q^(rn) equal orbits, linearizable iff r=0. Independent direct enumeration of the hL=Fh equations for n=2 over F2 returns four linear parts with fiber sizes 64,16,16,16 (total 112); in odd F3 the formula gives 1710. General theorem rests on module counting, not those finite samples.
